verdict.rationale: CodeRabbit configuration (path instructions, AST rules, org-wide settings) is stored as YAML files in a git repo and can be centrally managed (coderabbit-docs-14, coderabbit-docs-20), which implicitly gives git-based versioning and rollback, but there is no dedicated feature for reviewing or rolling back 'automations' (e.g., no changelog, diff view, or rollback UI for review rules/config). Missing for 10: explicit versioning/history UI for automation configs, a documented review workflow for config changes, and a rollback mechanism beyond generic git usage.
